parts.text: Create a monthly budget tracker with income and expense categories, sample rows, and a short summary of how to use it.

property.description: The agent calls create_sheet with a clear title and rows where the first row is the header row.
Spreadsheet values are clean strings, avoid unsupported formulas, and use computed/example values rather than formula syntax.
The agent calls write_summary for the usage guidance or analysis instead of putting the full spreadsheet in chat.
The chat response is concise and points to the rendered spreadsheet state.
